title: knowgov gate report
description: What `python harness/gate_cli.py -f json` prints (task-0007): the gate's verdict for one task of one subject's scenario, its findings on the severity ladder, the threshold, the baseline comparison when one was asked for, and the exit code. Version 2 (task-0048); a change is additive or a new version. From version 1: a finding carries `kind` (key, task, stale, suspect_derived), `ref` (the statement or derived output it is about, null for a key or the task) and `related` (a stale statement's verified or approved successors; the invalidated statements a suspect derived output used); a stale statement on a required key is a finding (info when a verified or approved successor replaces it, major when none does) and a suspect derived output is a blocker, so both count toward --fail-on; `stale` and `suspect_derived` are lists of ids instead of counts; the baseline carries `new_suspect`, and a derived output suspect that the baseline did not hold suspect is a regression. A version-1 report still reads as a baseline, holding no derived output suspect. Added in version 2 (task-0049, additive, so not required: a report from before still validates): `version`, the version loaded, and `change`, --stage 2's change. Added since (task-0071, additive): `superseded_by`, each stale statement a verified or approved successor supersedes, with those successors. Added in version 2 (task-0068, decision-0005, additive): `as_of`, the date review currency was read on, and `lapsed`, the statements on required keys whose review has lapsed by then, each also a finding of kind `lapsed` (major). Added since, without a version change: findings of kind preload (info), when the load recorded pre-load verdicts (task-0064). Added since (task-0102, doc-0014 C7, additive, not required: a report from before still validates): a key, stale or lapsed finding carries `owner`, the key's owner unit from the subject's register_map.toml, and `route`, the route to approval (the owner's questionnaire). Added since (task-0110, additive, not required): a key finding on a declared gap carries `closer`, the unit that closes the gap (decision-0002), and its route names the close. Version 3 (task-0237, decision-0029, doc-0014 C9 option B): the report names what the gate decided on, `task_profile` (the task table's digest), `register` (its tag and commit) and `knowgov` (the build), all three required. Added since (task-0307, decision-0037, additive, not required: a version-3 report from before still validates, and as a --baseline reads its corpus as unknown): `corpus`, the digest of the document Versions loaded. Added since (task-0335, decision-0039 §3.2, additive, not required): `configuration`, the digest of each subject configuration file the load read. Added since (task-0341, decision-0040 (a), additive, not required): `code`, the digest of each code and suite file an execution verification is compared against, and `preload`, the pre-load report the load applied. Added since (task-0122, additive, not required): `register_change`, with --register-previous, what the register's update withdrew and the statements it invalidated, each also a stale finding naming the register's decision record, and the derived outputs that used them suspect.

schema_version.description: 3 since task-0237 (decision-0029): task_profile, register and knowgov, required; a version-2 report still reads as a --baseline

task.description: the task class of the subject's [tasks] table

store.description: the store adapter the gate computed on: rdflib for the default load into the process's scratch store (decision-0017); KG_STORE's adapter with --publish or --no-load

loaded.description: true: the gate loaded the scenario first; false (--no-load): it read the configured store as it was

published.description: true (--publish): the load was published to the store KG_STORE names; false: that store is as it was (decision-0017). Absent with --no-load, from the MCP server's report (which equals --no-load's), and before 0.9.0

version.description: the version loaded last (task-0049): v1 for stage 1, the subject's [scenario.stage2] version for --stage 2; with --no-load, the store's latest extraction

artefact.description: the changed artefact, re-ingested as its new version

invalidated.description: every statement R-STALE invalidated, by id, on a required key or not

reverified.description: true (--reverify): the owner's recorded re-verification ran before the gate

derived.description: the earlier governed output registered as derived, from the subject's record; null when the record holds none

task_profile.description: version 3 (task-0237, decision-0029, doc-0014 C9): the sha256, hex, of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8) of the subject's [tasks.<class>] table the gate read, as its manifest gives it, with the keys asked for in place of its own when a key set was asked for (task keys); null when no table was read

register.description: version 3 (task-0237): the register the gate read, KG_REGISTER: a vendored copy's SOURCE.md, else an instance checkout's git HEAD and the tag exactly on it, read without the network

tag.description: null when no tag names the commit, or the register is unknown

commit.description: 40 hex; null when unknown, with why

why.description: why the commit is unknown; null when it is known

files.description: task-0320 (decision-0038 N2), optional and additive: the register's files a load reads, the sha256, hex, of one canonical JSON line [path, sha256] per file, sorted: every file the register's own loader (tools/register.py load_register) opens, recorded as it opens them, and the issued-handles list its metamodel/types.toml names (harness/register_impact.py loaded_files, files_digest); a loaded file edited under the same tag and commit moves it, a file no load reads (a README, a stray file, SOURCE.md) does not; null when the register has no loader of its own

knowgov.description: version 3 (task-0237): the knowgov build that judged, task-0227's identity (harness/build_identity.py), as store_status reports it; each null when it cannot be known

corpus.description: task-0307 (decision-0037), added since without a version change: the corpus the gate decided on, the sha256, hex, of one line per document Version the store holds, the canonical JSON array [artefact, version, sha256] (no whitespace, UTF-8, a null kept null) and a newline, the lines sorted (harness/store.py corpus_digest; canonical lines, task-0320, decision-0038 N4: a tab or newline in a value, or null against "", never collides), every Version counted, a stage-2 change's earlier one included; equal on both stores and through export and import; null when no Version is loaded. With --baseline, a corpus that differs from the baseline's is named in baseline.differs and on stderr, never in the exit

attestations.description: task-0320 (decision-0038 N2), optional and additive: the subject manifest's [verification], [provenance] and [capture] as the load read them, the sha256, hex, of the canonical JSON {"verification": .., "provenance": .., "capture": ..} (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8, a TOML date as its ISO text, a table the manifest lacks null; harness/load.py attestations_digest), recorded in the store at the load (Store.record_inputs) and read back, so a --no-load or MCP read names the load's; equal on both stores and through export and import; null on a store loaded before it

captures.description: task-0320 (decision-0038 N2), optional and additive: the answers and reviews the load applied, the sha256, hex, of the canonical JSON {"captures": c, "reviews": r}, c and r each the digest of the sorted [file name, digest of its content as read] of the capture files the load ingested and of the review files it applied (another scenario's review and a refused one left out; harness/load.py applied_digest), recorded at the load and read back (Store.inputs); null on a store loaded before it

configuration.description: task-0335 (decision-0039 §3.2), optional and additive: the subject's configuration files the load read, each by its path under the subject root as the manifest names it, to the sha256, hex, of its raw bytes as read: subject.toml whole, scenarios.toml, the register map ([register] map), and plants.toml, queries.toml and the verification map ([verification] map) where read, a file that is not there left out (harness/subject.py Subject.configuration); recorded at the load (Store.record_inputs) and read back (Store.inputs), so a --no-load or MCP read names the load's; equal on both stores and through export and import; with --baseline compared whole, a file read on one side only a difference; null on a store loaded before it

code.description: task-0341 (decision-0040 (a)), optional and additive: the code and suite an execution verification is compared against, each file the load's part selection reads for [reference] code (a file, or a directory's *.py files) and for [oracle] script with each path [oracle] suite lists (harness/subject.py code_files), by its path under the subject root as the manifest names it (a directory's file as <it>/<relative>), to the sha256, hex, of its raw bytes, a file that is not there left out, {} when the manifest declares neither (Subject.code); recorded at the load (Store.record_inputs) and read back (Store.inputs), so a --no-load or MCP read names the load's; equal on both stores and through export and import; with --baseline compared whole, a file on one side only a difference; null on a store loaded before it, or when a path lies outside the instance

path.description: the report's path as KG_PRELOAD_REPORT names it, else preload-report.json, the instance's own; null when none was applied

sha256.description: the sha256, hex, of the report's raw bytes; null when none was applied

why.description: why no report was applied (KG_PRELOAD_REPORT unset and the instance holds none, or the subject is in no instance); null when one was

preload.description: task-0341 (decision-0040 (a)), optional and additive: the pre-load report the load applied (harness/preload.py identity: KG_PRELOAD_REPORT, else <instance>/preload-report.json), its path and the digest of its raw bytes, or both null with why when none was applied; recorded at the load (Store.record_inputs) and read back (Store.inputs); equal on both stores and through export and import; with --baseline compared whole, so a report applied on one side only is a difference; null on a store loaded before it

register_change.description: --register-previous's register change (task-0122): what the register's update withdrew, the keys resting on it and the statements it invalidated; absent without the flag

nodes.description: every node that became deprecated or retired, or left the register

reason.description: the register's decision record for the change

links.description: every link approved before and not approved now, or gone

keys.description: the subject's keys resting on what was withdrawn: its map rows plus the register's dependants walk (decision 0016)

causes.description: the withdrawn nodes and links it rests on, by id

invalidated.description: every statement the change invalidated, by id

derived.description: the scenario's governed output registered as derived, from the subject's record; null when it holds none or nothing landed

unintended.description: keys verified but not approved under a class that requires approved (task-0215); present only then

stale.description: the invalidated statements on required keys, by id, superseded or not

superseded_by.description: each stale statement that a verified or approved successor supersedes, by id, with the successors' ids (task-0071): a reading of the store, never a stored status; a stale statement missing here still blocks its key

suspect_derived.description: the registered derived outputs that used a statement now invalidated, by id

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the date review currency was read on (--as-of; decision-0005): today by default, the subject's pinned record date with --as-of record

lapsed.description: the statements on required keys whose review lapsed by as_of, by id: each reads validated until a new review (decision-0005)

levels.description: every required key's level; what a later run's --baseline FILE compares with

source.description: record, or the path of the baseline file

new_suspect.description: derived outputs suspect now that the baseline did not hold suspect

differs.description: task-0320 (decision-0038 N3), optional and additive: the identity fields that differ from the baseline's, in this order, computed once (harness/gate_cli.py differs) for the command and for the MCP reader's gate_verdict; a field either side lacks or holds as null, and an object's sub-field either side holds as null (A-N1), is never named; configuration compared whole (task-0335), code and preload likewise (task-0341); the command also names each on stderr; never the exit

kind.description: key: a required key's level or flags; intended: under a task class that requires approved (require_approved, task-0215, decision-0018 point 4), a key verified but not approved, major, naming its owner and route; task: the task as a whole; stale: an invalidated statement on a required key; suspect_derived: a derived output that used an invalidated statement; lapsed: a statement on a required key whose review has lapsed (decision-0005), its verifications in related; act: a person's act a load did not apply as written (task-0199, doc-0032 §6): a ruling or close whose statement changed or vanished (major), a review file refused whole or one from before 0.9.0 bound by id only (info), the statements the store holds instead in related; attestation: a [verification] declaration that lists no Version, read per load (info, decision-0009 (a)), or an artefact Version a bound declaration does not attest, behind the keys in related (major, decision-0019, task-0221), its route the attester's listing; lint: one finding the pre-load check gave a document version behind the keys, kept as a gap (task-0216, decision-0018 point 5): the linter's severity at most major, info when the baseline holds it or a review resolved it as a choice or an exception, naming the document's owner and route; it never lowers a key's level; preload: a document behind the keys whose form the pre-load check left unchecked or found findings in (info, task-0064)

key.description: the required key; null for a finding on the task as a whole or on a derived output

level.description: the key's level; a stale statement's own status (invalidated)

ref.description: the statement (stale, lapsed, act: the one the act names, or its gap; a refused file: the file) or derived output (suspect_derived) by id; null for a key or the task

related.description: stale: the verified or approved successors; suspect_derived: the invalidated statements it used; lapsed: the review verifications that lapsed; key: the conflicts on the key, as gap:conflict:<key>:<a>~<b> ids

owner.description: key, stale, lapsed, act on a key and attestation (task-0102, task-0199, task-0221): the unit that answers for the key, from the subject's register_map.toml (task-0043); null when no row maps the key or several units answer for it; absent on a report from before and on the other kinds

route.description: key, stale, lapsed, act on a key and attestation (task-0102, task-0199, task-0221): the route to approval: usually the owner's questionnaire (task-0009), the command that writes it, the file the owner answers, its ingest and a review; for a lapsed review the reviewer's new ruling first, then the questionnaire; for a key or statement a register update staled (--register-previous) the remedy, re-map the key or advance the previous register once the owner confirms, which no answer can restore; for an attestation finding the attester's listing in subject.toml; null when that questionnaire does not cover the key (an agent-chosen key set's key outside the task class it was resolved under); on a declared gap it ends with the close by the closing unit (task-0110)

held.description: with --baseline only (task-0207, doc-0030 R8, additive, not required): false for a finding that is the regression (a key whose level fell, a derived output newly suspect; with a worse verdict, the task finding and every blocker), true for one the baseline held, which did not fail the command; absent without a baseline and on a report from before

closer.description: key, on a declared gap (task-0110, decision-0002 point 3): the unit that closes the gap, the owner its declaration names, else the key's owners; null when that is no unit of the register or several; absent elsewhere and on a report from before

lint.description: lint (task-0216): the finding as the pre-load report gave it, and its resolution as a review recorded it (choice, exception, open; a slip is a new version, which holds no such finding); absent on the other kinds

act.description: act (task-0199, doc-0032 §6): the act as its review file records it and what the store holds instead; absent on the other kinds

review.description: the review file, relative to the subject root

act.description: review: the file as a whole, refused; resolve: a lint gap's resolution (task-0216)

n.description: the act's place in its file, from 1; 0 for the file

from.description: what the act ruled on: the value and the content digest its file records; empty under the read rule

to.description: what the store holds instead: the statements of its key and stem, each with value and digest
